title: Vehicle-state UDP payload
description: UTF-8 JSON datagrams pushed to udp://127.0.0.1:9100 (or the targets in ADAS_UDP_TARGETS). All fields are optional — producers send partial updates. Consumers SILENTLY DROP unrecognized keys, so additionalProperties is false here to catch producer typos during validation. Keys mirror adas_protocol/keys.py.

speed.description: km/h, from any speed source (gearbox sender, GPS, OBD, ...)

fcw_warning.description: ADAS: collision risk ahead, driver should brake

fcw_ttc.description: ADAS: time to collision, s (0 = unknown)

speed_limit.description: ADAS: speed limit in force, km/h (0 = unknown)

sign_seen.description: ADAS: class id of a sign just passed, e.g. speed_limit (its value goes in speed_limit), stop

module_status.description: ADAS: state of each module; send every cycle (doubles as a heartbeat)

system_fault.description: ADAS: empty = none, else a fault id such as camera_blocked

input.description: Driver control event (rotary encoder, buttons); one datagram per event
